headline: Wakefit Innovations Limited: SEBI Takeover Regulation Disclosure (Regulation 31(4))
sum: Wakefit Innovations Limited disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares or change in control event under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4). The disclosure was filed with NSE, indicating a material corporate action requiring public disclosure.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure triggers when promoter shareholding or control structure shifts materially; this signals either a new promoter entry, significant stake consolidation, or change-of-control that meets the 25% threshold or triggers Article 10(4) of SEBI Takeover Regulations-partners must verify the exact trigger and any parallel open offer or exemption filing.
detail: Wakefit Innovations Limited, a Bengaluru-based mattress and sleep-tech retailer, filed a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 with the NSE. This regulation mandates disclosure when an acquirer makes a substantial acquisition crossing thresholds (typically 25% or higher) or when a person acquires control. The filing indicates a material change in ownership or control structure. The exact acquirer identity, stake acquired, consideration, and conditions precedent are contained in the full Regulation 31(4) disclosure document filed on or around 16 June 2026.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure by acquirer once substantial acquisition is completed; timing and content requirements for public announcement.
Definition of 'acquisition' and threshold triggers (25%, 50%, 75% etc.); determines whether open offer is mandated.
Open offer conditions and exemptions (Article 10(4) relief for exempt acquisitions); parties must verify if open offer triggered.
Related party transaction disclosure and approval requirements if acquirer is a related party.
Continuous disclosure obligations for listed companies; material event intimation to exchange within 30 mins.

framework.ref: Wakefit's Articles of Association & Shareholders' Agreement
framework.note: Any pre-emptive rights, drag-along or tag-along provisions, or founder consent clauses that condition the acquisition.
If acquirer is foreign entity, FDI compliance and approval under Schedule 1 (sector caps, control restrictions).

conditions: Substantial acquisition meeting Regulation 3 threshold (typically 25% or above, or acquisition of control)
Completion of acquisition and filing of Regulation 31(4) disclosure with exchange
approvals: SEBI clearance or exemption (if open offer mandated, then CCI approval if applicable)
Stock exchange approval of disclosure filing
Possibly government approval if acquirer is foreign or if listed company operates in sensitive sectors
structure.novel: Standard SEBI takeover disclosure; likely a private equity or strategic buyer entry into Wakefit, a consumer mattress/sleep-tech brand. If foreign acquirer, may implicate FDI policy for Consumer & Retail sector.

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure post-completion of substantial acquisition.
Threshold for open offer and exemption relief; if acquirer crosses 25%, open offer may be mandated unless exempted.
If transaction triggers CCI jurisdiction (asset/turnover thresholds), pre-acquisition CCI approval may be required before completion.
